INSERT INTO cursor_configs (
            user_id,
            key_ciphertext,
            encryption_version,
            kms_key_id
        )
        VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4)
        ON CONFLICT (user_id) DO UPDATE SET
            key_ciphertext       = EXCLUDED.key_ciphertext,
            encryption_version   = EXCLUDED.encryption_version,
            kms_key_id           = EXCLUDED.kms_key_id,
            updated_at           = NOW()
        RETURNING
            user_id,
            key_ciphertext,
            encryption_version,
            kms_key_id,
            default_model_id,
            default_effort,
            created_at,
            updated_at
